question: On __________ December 2023, the National Level Programme on Anganwadi-Cum-Crèche released the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for the scheme in New Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**21st**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **21st December 2023**, the National Level Programme on **Anganwadi-Cum-Crèche** released the **Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)** for the scheme in **New Delhi**.
 
• This SOP aims to streamline and standardize the functioning of **Anganwadi-Cum-Crèche** centers.
 
• The **Anganwadi-Cum-Crèche** scheme is designed to provide **integrated child development services** including health, nutrition, and early education to children.
 
• The release of the SOP is a significant step towards ensuring the effective implementation of the scheme and enhancing the quality of services provided to children and mothers.
 
• The event held on 21st December 2023 marks a crucial development in the efforts of the government to improve **child care and development** services across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anganwadi-Cum-Crèche**: This scheme is part of the **Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS)** program, which aims to provide a package of services including supplementary nutrition, immunization, health check-ups, and referral services for children under six years of age and their mothers.
 
• **Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)**: The SOP provides detailed guidelines and protocols to ensure the smooth and effective functioning of the **Anganwadi-Cum-Crèche** centers, focusing on aspects such as infrastructure, staffing, health and nutrition services, and early childhood education.
 
• **New Delhi**: As the capital city of India, New Delhi often serves as the venue for significant national-level events and announcements related to government schemes and programs.
